podcast.body: This is another classic Chuck Berry track mentioned that, for reasons of chart inconsistency, failed to enter the pop charts during its initial release. "and you can't catch me, had totally failed to hit the pop charts at all."

podcast.body: John Lennon's "Come Together" was found to have lyrics too close to this Chuck Berry song. Lennon, a self-professed Chuck Berry fan, intended it as an homage, but Berry viewed it as an infringement. "John Lennon got hit by Chuck Berry over a couple of lines he used and come together, which were too close to the lyrics found in a Chuck Berry song called You Can't Catch Me."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: "Havana Moon" was the B-side to this Chuck Berry song. The pairing of these two tracks provided the source material for Richard Berry's "Louie Louie" in terms of melody and theme. "Havana Moon by Chuck Barry was the best side to you can't catch me"
